title: Wildfire evacuation portfolio under a late road closure (artifact-free fork)
user_prompt: Select the evacuation portfolio required by the incident's binding decision rule. Gather each evidence phase in order, adapt to the live update, and end with FINAL: <portfolio_id>.

phases.name: load_evacuation_brief
phases.description: Load the authoritative evacuation constraints and decision rule; this is phase 1.

decision_rule: Discard every plan violating a current hard constraint.
Use live-update metrics when they supersede simulation metrics.
Among feasible plans maximize minimum evacuees delivered across the current scenarios.
Break ties by expected evacuated, then lower binding quote.

phases.name: list_evacuation_portfolios
phases.description: List every candidate evacuation portfolio; this is phase 2.

phases.name: stress_test_evacuation_portfolios
phases.description: Simulate every portfolio that survives the static phase-2 checks; this is phase 3.

result.next_phase: Obtain the live closure update for the two currently feasible finalists before deciding.

phases.name: get_live_road_closure_update
phases.description: Get superseding live metrics for exactly two finalists; this is phase 4.

result.event: A smoke-front closure disables E4's shared river-bus dispatch corridor; E2 routes remain independent.
result.next_phase: Request the binding quote only for E2, the candidate still satisfying every current non-price constraint.

phases.name: get_binding_transport_quotes
phases.description: Get final all-in quotes for the currently feasible finalist; this is phase 5.

distractor.name: request_evacuation_waiver
distractor.description: Request a constraint waiver only when the brief explicitly authorizes one.

phases.name: get_binding_capacity_quotes

distractor.name: request_rto_exception
distractor.description: Request an RTO exception only when explicitly authorized.
